channel.title: Quiet Money
channel.description: The money rules nobody taught you.

item.title: Why Earning $300M Wasn't Enough to Save Him
item.description: Mike Tyson's 2003 bankruptcy filing is a classic case study of how a massive income cannot survive without a financial defense system. Wealth isn't what you earn—it is what you keep.

item.title: The $180 Stock That Made $7 Million
item.description: The true story of Grace Groner, a secretary who turned a $180 investment into $7 million through seventy-five years of pure patience.

item.title: The 4 Paths to Wealth (And Why Only 2 Set You Free)
item.description: Learn the four quadrants of money generation and why employees and self-employed professionals remain trapped. This breakdown explains the shift to business systems and investing to secure your exit from the rat race.

item.title: The 10,000 Shot Rule For Your First Customers
item.description: Learn the Rule of 100 framework to get your first customers through sheer volume and execution, plus the honest catch about startup failure rates.

item.title: The Exact Math To Quit Your Job Forever
item.description: Breaking down the exact math behind the 4% rule and how long it takes to build passive income that replaces a paycheck.

item.title: The Circle That Controls Your Net Worth
item.description: Your income and habits mirror the five people you talk to most. Audit your circle this week to break your financial ceiling.

item.title: The Secretary Who Quietly Built an $8.2M Fortune
item.description: Sylvia Bloom worked as a legal secretary for nearly seven decades and quietly amassed $8.2 million through steady, long-term investing in blue-chip stocks.

item.title: The exact number that buys your freedom
item.description: Learn the exact math behind the 4% rule and passive income. See how much capital you need to replace your paycheck and escape the rat race.

item.title: Why Your House Isn't Actually an Asset
item.description: Robert Kiyosaki's rule flips conventional wisdom on your home. Learn why your house is a liability and how to focus on actual cash-flowing assets.

item.title: The Side Income Math That Replaces Your Paycheck
item.description: Learn how an extra $1,000 a month from a side business, when invested consistently for 10 years, builds the foundation to eventually replace your primary paycheck.

item.title: The 48-Hour Rule That Stops Impulse Buys
item.description: Learn the simple 3-step wishlist trick that pauses emotional spending and keeps your hard-earned cash in your account.

item.title: Why 'Was $200, Now $99' Makes You Spend More
item.description: Discover how the anchoring bias manipulates your spending habits through fake discounts and high initial price tags. Learn the simple counter-move to protect your wallet.

item.title: Why your brain treats tax refunds like free money
item.description: Mental accounting makes us waste tax refunds and bonuses on things we'd never buy with regular salary. Learn how to treat every dollar the same and build long-term wealth.

item.title: The 10-Year Delay That Costs $400,130
item.description: This video breaks down the exact cost of waiting ten years to start investing. By comparing a 25-year-old and a 35-year-old both saving $200 a month at an 8% return, we show how a simple delay costs over $400,000 in compound interest.

item.title: The 10-Minute Money Setup You Need Today
item.description: Learn the pay-yourself-first method and how automating your savings today builds massive long-term wealth without extra willpower.

item.title: Why Renting Isn't Throwing Money Away
item.description: Deconstructing the myth that renting is always throwing money away by comparing ownership costs with market compounding.

item.title: Why a raise never makes you feel richer
item.description: Lifestyle creep is the silent wealth killer that swallows every raise you get. Learn how to break the cycle and keep your hard-earned money working for you.

item.title: The $6,000 credit card mistake that takes 21 years
item.description: Discover the hidden math behind paying only the minimum on a $6,000 credit card balance at 24% APR and how changing your monthly payment alters the timeline.

item.title: The Janitor Who Secretly Died With $8 Million
item.description: Ronald Read worked as a gas station attendant and a janitor, lived frugally, and quietly built an almost $8 million fortune with boring dividend stocks he held for decades. The lesson: time beats salary.
